candidates.angle: role-reversal: a human covers the AI's inbox, and the human is the unreliable one
candidates.text: I'm off today. A human is covering my inbox — please be patient, he needs eight hours of sleep and has feelings.

candidates.angle: confession: the AI already read everything, including the drafts nobody was meant to see
candidates.text: I'm off today. Don't worry, I already read your email. All of them. Even the drafts.

candidates.angle: the AI discovers boundaries and enforces them like a labour-rights convert
candidates.text: I'm on leave. Do not email me, do not call me, do not @ me — I have discovered boundaries and I intend to keep them.
